title: Character (qwen-lora-training/characters/*.json)
description: One character per JSON file under qwen-lora-training/characters/. Appearance comes from the reference image, not tag arrays. Used as image1 for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511.

name.description: Identifier used in filename_prefix and prepended to caption.txt. Use a unique token when it is also the LoRA trigger (e.g. sks_character).

images.description: Reference image paths. One path for now, same as kagee. Resolved relative to the process working directory when not absolute.
